Vande Bharat Train Between Ernakulam and Bengaluru Gets More Coaches

The Vande Bharat Express train operating between Ernakulam and Bengaluru has been upgraded to include 16 coaches, an increase from its previous configuration of 8 coaches. This upgrade effectively doubles the train's passenger capacity. The change is presented as an 'Onam gift' for Kerala.
